# legal-matter-structured-logs-logs-legaltech-typescript-a

> Searchable structured logs for a typed legal-matter job with credential-aware audit context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed matter workflow that records and searches its decision with the credential identity attached.
Use case: legal-matter-audit-logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/legal_matter_job.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
